body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> TenBu showcased its Bluetooth security tag 'nio' at CES 2010, which links with your mobile phone, Blackberry or PDA to create a first line of defense against the loss or theft of valuable items such as briefcases, laptops, car keys, data sticks and even the phone itself.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
